name: Bowbelly Decree
description: Draw one blade down a row of imagined stalks and let the second follow a pace behind.

name: Sicklegrip Covenant
description: Bring both sickles palm to palm before the chest and take the blow on the joined curves.

name: Deluge Glean
description: Walk the basin's soft ground without a sound, the blades low and quiet at the hips.

name: Paramount Sheave
description: Cut one blade high and one low in a furrow-shaped cross that leaves no safe height.

name: Sigilblade
description: Catch both of an opponent's wrists in two separate hooks and cross them on your own chest.

name: Strawpledge
description: Cradle an incoming blade between the curves and roll it downward along the paired edges.

name: Sovereign Greenedge
description: Sweep both blades in a gathering arc and cut every enemy within the basin of your reach.

name: Sigilgrass
description: Hook neck and wrist together and pull the opponent down onto the second blade's cut.

name: Vigor Reapedge
description: Close the blades from both rims of the guard at once like shears around a stalk.

name: Entropy Inwardbelly
description: The school's closing cut, in which both blades circle inward and seal every line of attack within reach.

name: Reapbanner
description: Glide the blade in a long low line and cut at the end of it as a hawk strikes.

name: Mighty Handleknob
description: Raise the blade overhead like a roof of sky and let a falling blow break against it.

name: Vigor Sickletang
description: Move on the balls of the feet in feather-light paces that give the opponent nothing to follow.

name: Tyrannous Hookblade
description: Lift the hook through the guard from below and catch the weapon arm as it descends.

name: Squall Tipcurve
description: Beat the blade out and back like a wing to turn two strikes in quick succession.

name: Reap Decree
description: Dive from a raised guard into a steep slash that finishes below the opponent's knees.

name: Squallblade
description: Rise on an updraft of qi to step past the guard and cut as the foot lands.

name: Radiance Sheave
description: Rip the hooked tip through the narrow seam beneath the arm like a hawk stripping a pinion.

name: Pealgrass
description: Pair the parry and the counter in one long sweep, the sky-side edge turning and the other cutting.

name: Vigorglean
description: Stoop through the guard in one flashing drop and land the hooked cut before it can close.

name: Noble Squall Greenedge
description: The school's signature fall, in which the hook and the edge cross over the foe and bring them down.

name: Haemalreap
description: Cut where two lines of motion meet so the blade arrives with the full weight of both.

name: Squallstraw
description: Slip off to the side like a tributary leaving the main stream and rejoin from behind.

name: Bladepledge
description: Plant firm like a bank stone and let the heavy blow part around the blade.

name: Crushing Harvest
description: Hook the opponent's arm and run one current of pull along the hook and one along the haft.

name: Thrall Sicklegrip
description: Draw the hook and the free hand together to a single point and pin the target there.

name: Squall Bowbelly
description: Turn the blade in a small eddy that spins a strike around and off its target.

name: Bedrock Handleknob
description: Chop with the slow, silt-laden weight of a river in flood so the blow lands deep.

name: Squall Reap
description: Step in widening ripples around the foe and slash as each ripple meets their guard.

name: Magnificent Glean
description: Send two sweeping arcs of qi from either hand to cross in front and cut all within.

name: Peal Inwardbelly
description: Pull the weapon down and away on a hidden undercurrent that the opponent cannot resist.

name: Illustrious Garner
description: Merge two long drawn cuts into one edge and finish through the guard they have trapped.

name: Paramount Crookspine
description: The school's final draw, where two flowing cuts meet in the target and become one stroke.

name: Bedrock Sickletang
description: Open with a courteous salute whose lowering blade becomes a quick cut across the forearm.

name: Consecrated Tipcurve
description: Hold two guard lines at once, one high and one low, with the pair of blades.

name: Bedrock Hookblade
description: Pace twice at the same length and speed, so the opponent cannot read which will change.

name: Sheavetroth
description: Pin the weapon arm with the left track's hook while the right track prepares its cut.

name: Thunderclap Stook
description: Finish with a clean slice from the right track across the line that the left has opened.

name: Deluge Reapedge
description: Parry with one blade while the other travels in a courteous mirrored arc to answer.

name: Millstone Garner
description: Cross both hooks over the opponent's weapon and seize it between the tracks.

name: Haemal Harvest
description: Draw both edges across the foe in a slow, deliberate stroke once their guard has failed.

name: Vigorstook
description: Run both tracks of qi into a single edge and drive one cut that carries the weight of two.

name: Fearless Quenched Stook
description: The school's judging cut, where the foe is held between two edges and cut by both.

name: Gleanedict
description: Cut at the farthest edge of the blade's reach and snap it home before the foe can answer.

name: Immaculate Inwardbelly
description: Hold the blade rim-up before the body and let the blow break against its upturned curve.

name: Ruinous Sheave
description: Cover a long distance in three light steps like a hawk crossing a distant field.

name: Grasstroth
description: Cast the hook out through the qi field and catch an opponent a long pace beyond your arm.

name: Steel Crookspine
description: Slash upward from the basin floor in a long curve that finishes above the foe's head.

name: Grassseal
description: Meet a talon-like hook with your own and wrench it aside, turning its force back.

name: Commanding Greenedge
description: Throw a wide snare of qi around the foe and close it with a pull of the hook.

name: Magma Stook
description: Spread the qi field across the open ground and sweep a far-reaching arc of cuts.

name: Titan Handleknob
description: Grip the target with the field's qi and pull them across the ground into reach of the edge.

name: Interstice Sickletang
description: Flash across the field in one plunge and cut the target before their eyes catch up.

name: Unrivaled Reap
description: The school's far-reaching strike, in which the curved edge crosses the field to its target in one pass.

name: Triumphant Crookspine
description: Pull the blade through the cut with a steady stream of qi that does not falter.

name: Deluge Bowbelly
description: Keep the feet low and flat as on a riverbed, walking over stones without a slip.

name: Sainted Hookblade
description: Let the blade glide against a blow as water glides over a stone and turn it away.

name: Millstone Tipcurve
description: Curve the hook in a river's bend around an arm and draw it round behind the back.

name: Millstone Harvest
description: Warm the hook from the core and draw the opponent steadily in against their strength.

name: Stookcrown
description: Slash with a deep current of core qi that carries the cut well past the surface.

name: Parity Sicklegrip
description: Turn at the top of the opponent's strike like a tide and send the cut back along it.

name: Quenched Reapedge
description: Rise from a deep crouch in a cut that wells up from the core like a spring.

name: Dunestraw
description: Send a stream of core qi sweeping in a broad arc through everything before the blade.

name: Thrall Reap
description: Pull the hooked foe toward you with the building force of a flood at its source.

name: Thunderclap Glean
description: Break the river's whole stored weight through the point and pierce the strongest guard.

name: Lordly Inwardbelly Edict
description: The school's rising cut, in which the curve is fed continuously until it breaks upward through the foe.

name: Haemalblade
description: Speak the vow beneath the breath and draw the blade through the cut as the last word falls.

name: Sacrosanct Greenedge
description: Brace feet and blade as if on the bare plateau floor and let the blow spend itself.

name: Vigor Handleknob
description: Move at the pace of the wind across the plateau, quick when it gusts and still when it falls.

name: Sundering Crookspine
description: Lift the weapon arm on the sworn hook and hold it high above the shoulder.

name: Enshrined Sickletang
description: Turn a strike aside along the blade like a ledge sheds rain, and step through.

name: Hookblade Decree
description: Slash along the bearing already fixed on the target and hold the line to the end.

name: Thrall Sheave
description: Anchor the hook into the wind's pull and drag the opponent steadily along the cutting edge.

name: Subjugating Tipcurve
description: Hold the hook fast as an oath and throw the opponent over it onto the cutting edge.

name: Consecrated Reapedge
description: Stand at the plateau's edge, turn the strike toward the drop and cut back along it.

name: Quenched Garner
description: Put the whole sworn weight of the vow into a single clean cut that cannot be turned.

name: Splendid Vigor Bowbelly
description: The academies' signature draw, a single unbroken pull of the blade that holds the vow from start to finish.

name: Haemal Sicklegrip
description: Take the bearing on a distant mark and slice along its straight line.

name: Stookvoyage
description: Pace heel-first with the cutter's patient stride, each step keeping the bearing true.

name: Prismstraw
description: Turn the blade's edge into the gust and take a blow on its flat as the wind presses.

name: Tyrannous Stook
description: Correct the hook's line by a finger's width mid-pull and catch the arm that tried to slip.

name: Peal Hookblade
description: Cut across the wind into the opponent's strike so it fails and the counter lands.

name: Squall Glean
description: Drift a half pace downwind and slash the opponent's flank as it turns to follow.

name: Grassdecree
description: Sweep a wide arc across the wind on a fixed bearing and cut all who stand on it.

name: Garnerpledge
description: Hook the opponent along the bearing and drop them flat with the cut following.

name: Squall Garner
description: Hold the bearing against every distraction until one final strike goes down its exact line.

name: Squall Sicklegrip
description: The course's closing strike, a cut along a bearing held so truly that no guard can stand on it.

name: Garner Decree
description: Pull the blade across with no wall at your back and no need to guard against one.

name: Parityblade
description: Fan the blade wide so that no side of the body is left uncovered in the open.

name: Twilit Tipcurve
description: Stride widely across level country and make the opponent chase the distance.

name: Searing Glean
description: Sling the hook outward on a gust and catch the opponent's cloak or arm.

name: Thrall Harvest
description: Spread the hook's qi across open ground and snare the legs of an advancing foe.

name: Parity Sickletang
description: Sweep the parry in the wind's direction so the push helps turn the blow.

name: Heroic Reapedge
description: Spread the stance low and wide and slash upward through the opponent's lead leg.

name: Handleknob Vow
description: Catch the strike on the hook and pull in a wide arc that carries the attacker past.

name: Solar Sheave
description: Sweep a boundless arc of qi across the field with no wall to stop the cut.

name: Peal Greenedge
description: Strip the weapon from a fighter's grip and fling it into the open sky.

name: Steel Bowbelly
description: Flash across open ground where nothing blocks the way and cut the target as you arrive.

name: Savage Stook
description: The school's final sweep, a wide arc that cuts all foes in an open field with nothing to stop it.

name: Strawbanner
description: Speak the oath, then draw the blade through a bundle of straw in a single even pull.

name: Strawtroth
description: Tie the guard to the wind's direction and brace the blade where the gust would blow.

name: Fierce Tipcurve
description: Step lightly as though on loose straw and spread the weight so nothing rustles.

name: Millstone Reapedge
description: Hook the arm as one hooks a handful of straw and bind it with a short sharp pull.

name: Sainted Crookspine
description: Cut across a blow in the same direction as the wind and carry it harmlessly off.

name: Famed Inwardbelly
description: Slash along the line spoken in the oath and permit no wavering from it.

name: Unbending Sickletang
description: Wrap the hook around the limb in a slow drag that cuts as it tightens.

name: Tyrannous Bowbelly
description: Bind the opponent's weapon arm with a hook sworn to hold until the fight is decided.

name: Peal Crookspine
description: Yield to the strike like straw in wind, then spring back with a cut as it passes.

name: Pulsarstook
description: Pass the sworn point through a headwind and the guard behind it without slowing.

name: Steelgrass
description: The school's sworn cut, where the oath, the wind and the blade become one clean stroke.

name: Stookverdict
description: Draw the cut into a high steady wind that leans on the blade's back.

name: Prism Hookblade
description: Stand tall like a ridge-top and hold the guard where the wind meets the blow.

name: Stookboon
description: Skip upwind in light bounds that the highwind helps carry onward.

name: Titan Reap
description: Hook the target and pull it toward the rim, the drop at its heels.

name: Peal Sicklegrip
description: Angle the blade so the highwind carries an incoming cut wide of the body.

name: Vigorblade
description: Slash along the ridge line of the opponent's shoulder and arm in one smooth plunge.

name: Gleantriumph
description: Loose a sweeping hook of qi along the highwind's course through every foe on the ridge.

name: Pall Inwardbelly
description: Fall with the rim's drop to slip under a strike and cut upward on the return.

name: Seasonreap
description: Flash out beyond the rim in one leap and cut the foe from where no footing exists.

name: Unbending Thrall Handleknob
description: The school's rim cut, in which the foe is hooked at the edge and dropped over it.

name: Squall Harvest
description: Pull the blade with the wind drawn along its curve and let it add speed to the cut.

name: Gleanodyssey
description: Step on the exhale of the core's breath so every pace is perfectly weighted.

name: Faithful Bowbelly
description: Draw the curve across the front of the body and let the wind hold it steady against a blow.

name: Unbending Sheave
description: Let a gust draw the hook out and around the opponent's arm before you pull.

name: Mighty Garner
description: Pull the hooked foe in with a steady current of core qi and wind together.

name: Quenched Greenedge
description: Slash with the wind drawn tight along the edge until it sings against the target.

name: Squall Crookspine
description: Draw the curve under an attack and out in a counter that cuts as it turns the blow.

name: Deluge Garner
description: Ride a gust forward into a step that ends in a cut before the opponent's guard resets.

name: Tipcurve Decree
description: Gather core qi and the wind into one broad sweep that cuts all before the blade.

name: Peal Stook
description: Strip the weapon from the foe's hand with a hook drawn out on the wind.

name: Fearless Glean
description: Draw all the surrounding wind to the edge and cut in a single flash through the foe.

name: Imperial Steel Handleknob
description: The school's unfurling cut, in which the drawn wind is released along the sickle's curve all at once.
